item.description: Azure DevOps is a comprehensive advanced project management solution designed to help businesses streamline their operations and improve productivity. Whether you’re a small startup or a large enterprise, Azure DevOps scales to meet your needs while maintaining the simplicity that makes it accessible to users of all technical levels.
